intent: Make a simple countdown timer web page that counts down from 60 seconds.

spec.goal: Have a simple web page with a countdown timer that counts down from 60 seconds.
spec.deliverable: A single simple web page that displays a countdown timer starting at 60 seconds.
constraints: The page must be a web page.
The timer must start at 60 seconds and count down.
Keep the design and functionality simple, with no extra features beyond the countdown.
done_criteria: The page opens in a web browser and shows a timer set to 60 seconds.
The displayed time counts down one second at a time.
The page is simple and contains no features beyond the countdown timer.
spec.summary: You want a simple web page with a timer that counts down from 60 seconds.
